# navig-agentctl

<!-- navig:plugin-card:start -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_plugin_catalog.py — edit the plugin's pyproject.toml, not this block. -->

> Agent Control Center (devops section): sessions, worktrees, tasks and the Agent Monitor (runs, hooks, verified lands) — one view, then a controller.

**A navig extension** — installing it pulls in navig and adds the commands below · v0.4.2 · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/navig-agentctl/)

**Install**

```bash
pip install "navig[agentctl]"
navig agentctl --help
```

It is not a separate program: it needs navig, and installing it installs navig for you.

<details><summary>Commands</summary>

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `navig agentctl ack` | Acknowledge a failed run so it stops lighting the Dock indicator. |
| `navig agentctl bind` | Claim a task for a session. Rebinding MOVES the owner (one claim per task). |
| `navig agentctl bindings` | Active task <-> session claims (one claim per task — no duplicate execution). |
| `navig agentctl hooks install` | Add the Agent Monitor hooks to Claude Code settings (shows the diff first). |
| `navig agentctl hooks status` | Which Claude Code settings files carry the monitor hooks. |
| `navig agentctl hooks uninstall` | Remove only the Agent Monitor hooks; every other hook is left as it was. |
| `navig agentctl run` | Run a command as a monitored, verified process:  navig agentctl run -- <command…> |
| `navig agentctl runs` | Agent runs: sessions, subagents, commands and lands, live and historical. |
| `navig agentctl sessions` | Live agent sessions (who is working where, idle or active). |
| `navig agentctl show` | One run in detail: state, stages, history, and optionally its log tail. |
| `navig agentctl status` | One-line overview: sessions, worktrees (cwd repo), tasks. |
| `navig agentctl tasks` | Unified tasks from the board and the work queue. |
| `navig agentctl unbind` | Release a task claim (the ledger keeps the history). |
| `navig agentctl worktrees` | Git worktrees of a repo: branch, ahead/behind, dirty, last commit. |

</details>

<!-- navig:plugin-card:end -->

**Agent Control Center** — the devops section for managing AI coding agents across
sessions, git worktrees and task records. Local-first, provider-agnostic, read-only
in Phase 1.

## Phases

| Phase | Name | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Observer | Discover live agent sessions · list worktrees + conflict radar · unified task read-model (board + work queue). **Changes nothing.** |
| 2a | Heartbeat | `POST /api/deck/agents/heartbeat` — the extension annotates workspace/editor/roster context; daemon-owned `state`/`pid`/`reason` are never written. |
| **2b (this)** | Bindings | The task-binding ledger: one active claim per task (`bind`/`unbind`), ownership chips in the Control Center. Process control (launch/pause/terminate) is still ahead. |
| 2c | Controller | Launch CLI agents into worktrees, assign task specs, pause/terminate owned processes, collect handoff reports, detect ownership conflicts. |
| 3 | Orchestrator | Schedule by dependency, allocate by capacity, trigger reviews, recover interrupted work — production deploys always ask a human first. |

## CLI

```
navig agentctl sessions [--project P] [--json]
navig agentctl worktrees [--project PATH] [--conflicts] [--json]
navig agentctl tasks [--source board|work] [--json]
navig agentctl status [--json]
navig agentctl bindings [--all] [--json]
navig agentctl bind <task-ref> --session <id> [--note TEXT] [--json]
navig agentctl unbind <task-ref> [--json]
```

## Deck routes (the contract)

All under `/api/deck/agents`, gated on the `agentctl` module. Reads are GET-only; writes are
annotation/ledger only (no process control):

- `GET /api/deck/agents/sessions` — live sessions (from `navig procs` semantics) merged with the persistent registry.
- `GET /api/deck/agents/worktrees?project=&conflicts=` — worktrees + pairwise conflict radar.
- `GET /api/deck/agents/tasks` — board cards + work items, one normalised shape.
- `POST /api/deck/agents/heartbeat` — annotation-only session context (daemon truth wins).
- `GET /api/deck/agents/bindings[?all=1]` / `POST` / `DELETE /{task_ref}` — the claim ledger.

The OS app (Control Center tile) and navig-dev (VS Code tree views) are both
consumers of this one contract.

## Store

`~/.navig/data/store/agentctl.db` — session ledger (who was active where, with
state-change history) and task bindings (which session owns which task). Task
truth stays in `board.db` / `work.db`; this ledger only answers ownership.

## Non-negotiables

Local-first · provider-agnostic adapters · explicit process ownership · safe git
handling · no duplicate task execution · **no automatic merge or deployment**.
